test_title: PYST 16: SSC CGL - Reasoning (Held On : 20 April 2022 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question: In a certain code language, ‘NAILS’ is written as ‘PYGNU’, and ‘TEXT’ is written as ‘VCZV. How will ‘FOREST’ be written in that language?
solution:
The position of letters according to the English alphabet series:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5c0eb12f87e782cab4b30b333b755fb7e44381c390fd941436ceeee8bd8f81ba.png] 

**Logic: In Vowel - Subtraction of - 2 in vowels.**

**In consonant - Addition of + 2 in consonant.**

‘NAILS’ is written as ‘PYGNU’

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9ad9f5bc94f870b6297622c2dcd64fca2852dda67973afa28773428353c04840.png] 

And,

‘TEXT’ is written as ‘VCZV

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/93046be3a4e23e8ea0bc9f7db5caacc03dea5eb30581049cf98075ddb788e762.png] 

Similarly,

‘FOREST’ is written as '?'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dbede5cda9e309396f9b169b3212d646f4544617a07f96c7f728e632da011f2f.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"HMTCUV".**
